While this setup gives AI agents a fast inner loop for subroutine optimization, moving toward end-to-end fault-tolerant compilation suggests two main directions: 1. That code choice then determines how the architecture implements logical gates and what overheads arise from magic-state distillation, qubit routing, and reaction time [7, 10, 12, 29, 30]. Future benchmarks can keep kickmix simulation to check logical correctness while scoring submissions with a QEC cost model for a target architecture.

Many quantum subroutines, such as state preparation, quantum signal processing, and fermionic rotations, create superpositions internally and cannot be checked by a kickmix simulator.
